author: buschic
text:
Samsung screwed over its most loyal, longtime fans.. I am a 31yr fan of Samsung Phones, since they introduced Note/Ultra, that’s what I have bought since… I most recently had a S25 Ultra, what an absolute piece of garbage, I sold it & went back to my S24 Ultra, until late last year, when my beloved S24U died, Samsung didn’t want to honour my SCare+ & tried screwing me around, all because the main motherboard fried itself, after under 2yrs of having it, (it was a Samsung official replacement device, after my first one came brand new with a dead screen) Samsung wanted ($375 to replace the motherboard)

This, added to the fact that google/samsung are severely lacking accessibility features, & not really upgrading it.

I saw the specs of the iPhone 17 Pro Max, I know about the incredible accessibility features of iOS devices as well.

After buying almost every other NOTE/Ultra, device since the OG Note, I’d had enough BS, I wanted a 1+, (but didn’t want the hassle of getting it here), so with my love of android geekery & my beloved Nova Launcher Prime, all but dead, I switched..

iPhone 17 Pro Max

2TB

SILVER

(It was actually cheaper to get that than replace my beloved S24 Ultra)

This phone is insane, it’s stood up to my abuse, using it as my laptop constantly, running it over with my 740lb power wheelchair, dropping it a lot, beating the hell out of it, it’s SOLID.

The accessibility features just destroy ANYTHING android can do, in so many ways.

I’m sad to see Samsung rely so heavily on AI, it means the when they start charging for the features (& they will) that the devices are going to be so reliant on it, that they are going to be useless without the fancy AI & the upcharges that will be demanded..

I always kept my AI features disabled or deleted, I don’t need all that fancy crap.

I only miss my S-Pen, being Bluetooth, I used it many times each day.

I am sure there are going to be many more people like me.

I still love Samsung, I’m done with the lacklustre design of recent devices..
